name: jambavan
description: Local-first MCP server for coding agents: rootless persistent memory, AST-aware code index, token-budgeted context, failure records, review packs, prompt compression, and a local graph GUI. Twenty tools: code index (jambavan_index, jambavan_context, jambavan_watch, jambavan_doctor), structural code graph and impact (jambavan_graph, jambavan_impact), prompt compression (jambavan_compress_prompt), durable memory (jambavan_memory_store, jambavan_memory_read, jambavan_memory_mine_session, jambavan_memory_forget, jambavan_memory_status), session continuity (jambavan_failure_store, jambavan_failure_search, jambavan_session_handoff, jambavan_review_pack), dev workflow (jambavan_debt_ledger, jambavan_awaken), and guarded file/shell tools (read_file, search, list_files; write_file, patch_file, bash opt-in). Discipline protocols ship as MCP prompts rather than tools: root_cause, verify_gate, strategy_plan, decompose_task, dev_rules. Pre-2.0 tool names still resolve. It does not call an LLM or upload code; repository indexes and the global memory archive stay local.
